Definition: rheumatic or crippled (from the incident to Jacob)
BiblicalUsage: The sinew that shrank in Jacob's thigh is remembered in the law: Israel would not eat it, because that was where Jacob was struck when he wrestled through the night.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God leaves His mark on the ones He wrestles with, and Jacob walked away limping as the proof that he had met God and lived.
